scenes.title_cn: 开场：都市凭个灵感从哪来？当然从闲逛…
scenes.title_en: Opening: where does city inspiration come …
scenes.context: 闲逛收集街头文字作为灵感来源。
sentences: 灵感从哪来？当然从闲逛中来。
Where does inspiration come from? From wandering, of course.
from wandering（从闲逛来）
收集街头文字真的是非常适合闲逛的时候干的事情。
Collecting street lettering is perfect for wandering.
street lettering（街头文字）
你可以直接把它们用在Vlog里，就是作为首写自己的灵感来源。
Use them directly in vlogs as the source of typography inspiration.
typography source（字体灵感）
scenes.speak: Where does inspiration come from? From wandering, of course. Collecting street lettering is perfect for wandering. Use them directly in vlogs as the source of typography inspiration.

scenes.title_cn: 线路式灵感：接下来我去看了很多笼子，…
scenes.title_en: Line-style inspiration: next I saw many ca…
scenes.context: 像地铁线路一样一站接一站扩展灵感。
sentences: 就像地铁线路一样，从一个地方找到另一个地方。
Like the subway map, going from one place to another.
like a subway line（像地铁线路）
把线路铺开的话，你可能还会想到与这并列的更多主题。
Spread the line and you'll think of parallel themes.
spread the line（铺开线路）
这样线路图上的任意一站，都可以停进你的灵感库里。
Every station on the map can land in your inspiration library.
stations to library（站点入库）
paraphrase: like a subway line（像地铁线路
like a subway line（像地铁线路
scenes.speak: Like the subway map, going from one place to another. Spread the line and you'll think of parallel themes. Every station on the map can land in your inspiration library.

scenes.title_cn: 观影与城市对照：差点忘了，这才是苹果…
scenes.title_en: Movies and city comparison: almost forgot—…
scenes.context: 看一部与城市相关的电影，白天走过的路会重现。
sentences: 设备对于创作的界限真的是越来越小。
The device boundary to creation truly shrinks.
boundary shrinks（界限变小）
可以打开一部跟这个城市有关的电影，你白天去过的地方很可能就会出现在画面里。
Open a film set in that city—the places you visited may appear on screen.
city films（城市电影）
当电影结束以后，你又可以立刻回到故事发生的城市中。
When it ends, you step back into the story's city.
back to the city（回到城市）
scenes.speak: The device boundary to creation truly shrinks. Open a film set in that city—the places you visited may appear on screen. When it ends, you step back into the story's city.

scenes.title_cn: 公园与结语：同样令人上瘾的还有北京的…
scenes.title_en: Parks and conclusion: equally addictive ar…
scenes.context: 公园未必有灵感，以自嘲作结。
sentences: 同样令人上瘾的还有北京的公园，也是去了一个又想去另一个。
Equally addictive are Beijing's parks—one after another.
addictive parks（上瘾的公园）
你在公园这种地方还想有什么灵感？简直是在摧残你的灵感。
Inspiration in a park? You're torturing your inspiration.
torturing inspiration（摧残灵感）
scenes.speak: Equally addictive are Beijing's parks—one after another. Inspiration in a park? You're torturing your inspiration.

practice: Wandering the city gathers inspiration directly.
Follow threads like subway lines to new topics.
A film set in your city mirrors the places you visited.
Even parks—or the lack of it—feed creativity.
pitfalls: Go wander the city to collect it.
Collect street lettering and elements for vlogs.
Follow a clue like a subway line.
A film set in the city echoes your day.
Even a dead end can spark the next idea.
shifts: 用 wandering（闲逛）、inspiration library（灵感库）、threads（线索）
用 street lettering（街头文字）、elements（元素）、cages as frames（笼子做框）
用 city films（城市电影）、screenshot moments（抓取瞬间）、device boundary（设备界限）
